result.summary: The application interface displays a significant visual anomaly in the 'Popular right now' section where the card content overlaps and renders incorrectly.

issues.description: The card for 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' contains a large, misplaced image of a ramen bowl that completely overlays and obscures the text content (title, rating, metadata) which is only partially visible behind the bowl graphic.
issues.suggestion: Review the layout constraints for the 'Popular right now' card to ensure the background image layer is correctly positioned behind the text content and not obscuring it.
